slides.headline: 2) FIND EVERY TRAP IN A CONTRACT BEFORE YOU SIGN IT
slides.body: Most small business contracts hide at least one clause that costs the signer more than they expected. Unlimited revisions, auto-renewing fees, and non-compete traps are the most common.

slides.headline: 3) SEE THE CASH SHORTAGE ARRIVING IN 6 WEEKS BEFORE IT DOES
slides.body: Most owners find out about a cash crisis after it has already arrived. Paste your last 6 months of revenue and Claude maps exactly when the danger comes.

slides.headline: BEFORE IT HITS.

slides.headline: 4) FIND WHERE YOUR ONBOARDING LOSES NEW CLIENTS IN MONTH ONE
slides.body: Most clients who leave in the first 30 days had a doubt they never said out loud. It shows up in how they wrote to you early on.

slides.headline: 5) READ THE SIGNALS OF CLIENTS ABOUT TO LEAVE BEFORE THEY DO
slides.body: Clients who cancel rarely say it directly. They say it in the tone of their messages weeks earlier, and Claude finds who is already sending exit signals.

slides.headline: 6) FIND EXACTLY WHY YOUR LAST PROPOSAL LOST THE DEAL
slides.body: Most losing proposals fail in one specific place: a fear the client had that nobody addressed. Claude reads the rejection and finds it so the next proposal does not repeat the mistake.

caption:
Swipe through and save these 6 prompts. 💡 Each one catches a different business mistake before it costs you.

Pricing that is quietly wrong, contract clauses you did not notice, a cash shortage 6 weeks away, onboarding that loses clients in month one, clients already sending exit signals, and proposals failing in one specific place.

Most of these mistakes show up in your bank account after the fact. These prompts shift the timing so AI finds the problem before the money leaves. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Anthropic, Tesla
